basics.name: Tuan Do

basics.summary: Computer Science student at the University of Hawai`i at Mānoa specializing in full-stack web development and game programming. Experienced in building responsive web applications using Next.js, React, TypeScript, and PostgreSQL, as well as developing gameplay systems in Unity and C#.

education.institution: University of Hawaii at Manoa, Honolulu, HI

work.summary: High-volume retail customer service and daily stall operations.
highlights: Provided hospitalble and welcoming customer service in a high-traffic retail environment to 300+ customers per shift.
Orchestrated with coworkers to set up, organize, and dismantle the stall, safely loading and removing all merchandise and equipment after each sale.
Resolved customer inquiries independently to continuously changing customer demand and weather conditions, resolving issues independently and keeping sales running efficiently.

work.company: Game Development Club at University of Hawaii at Manoa
work.summary: Engineered gameplay mechanics and coordinated multi-developer game builds.
highlights: Constructed interactive gameplay mechanics and control systems in Unity with C#.
Collaborated across a cross-functional team of 20+ artists, designers, and programmers to deliver 2 playable game titles.
Integrated 40+ visual and audio assets into Unity game environments, supporting a cohesive player experience.
Debugged and play-tested builds to point out and resolve gameplay issues and improve overall performance.
Utilized Google Docs to maintain up-to-date project documentation, track issues, and document project progress.

projects.name: GAMEnCONNECT
highlights: Extending UH GameLink website with mobile compatibility for Android and iOS via React Native.
Integrating Docker to containerize the application and database, streamlining development setup and deployment.
Refactoring and optimizing backend API endpoints to accelerate app navigation by 50%.
Crafting responsive features and UI components to maximize user engagement on both mobile and web browser.

projects.name: UH GameLink
projects.summary: Full-stack web application for university game management.
highlights: Implemented role-based access control (RBAC) to enforce security across 15+ application routes, restricting unauthorized access via automated redirects.
Developed administrator and player management interfaces and modals backed by a PostgreSQL database.
Designed user profile creation workflows and 10+ customizable, reusable visual components in React.
Utilized Git and version control workflows to collaborate on full-stack web applications supporting university-wide administrative processes.
